author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at a big update regarding a movement that will keep our favourite games safe and in our hands. New laws threaten that preservation as it will become harder for anyone running a server to keep the lights on, how? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Stop Killing Games Is In Serious Trouble...
